invariants.statement: A player cannot escape a losing bet by choosing to refund after seeing the outcome
invariants.check: fork: probe Refund() at +0..+40 and after settle; measure reveal latency census
invariants.evidence: F01 (315 cycles, p50 5 blocks vs 2001-block gate), F02 (timing irrelevant — refund cannot be claimed inside a normal bet)

invariants.statement: Refunding a bet never also pays the bet
invariants.check: fork: refund a request, then deliver a KNOWN WINNING random
invariants.evidence: F02 §2 shape 4 — callback status 0x1, payout +0.0000, no logs, GetState stays zeroed

invariants.statement: A refund commitment cannot be created or reused outside its own pending request
invariants.check: fork: idle commit attempt; commit on A then reuse on B
invariants.evidence: F02 §2 shapes 2-3 — clock binds to the request (want = betBlock+2001) and resets per request

invariants.statement: A suspended player's in-flight funds remain retrievable
invariants.check: fork: self-suspend with a bet in flight, then settle a WIN and run the refund path
invariants.evidence: F03 §2 — payout +19.00 MON landed while suspended; refund +7.9998 MON

invariants.statement: No game configuration lets a player bet at positive EV
invariants.check: enumerate all 225 valid (numMines, numRevealed) cells via the view and compare to C(25,r)/C(25-m,r)

invariants.statement: Player-supplied game state is rejected when out of range
invariants.check: fork: call with out-of-range values, decode the error
invariants.result: PARTIAL — Mines numMines verified (4..23, InvalidNumMines 0x822cb1a0). HiLo/Keno NOT testable: addresses unmapped

invariants.statement: The pool always holds enough to pay every bet it has accepted
invariants.check: fork A/B: settle a winning bet with the pool intact vs after an owner drain
invariants.result: VIOLATED BY THE OPERATOR — pool intact: +190.00 paid; drained: callback reverts, player +0.00, request stuck awaiting=1 forever

invariants.statement: LP share value is not diluted or inflatable by donation
invariants.check: fork: deposit, donate directly to the contract, deposit again; compare shares per MON
invariants.result: BLOCKED — deposit() reverts for every positive amount, so no LP position can be created to test with
invariants.evidence: F05 (deposit probe) — the blocker is itself the finding
